subject: Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance
overview: The City Council approved major free cash appropriations to stabilization funds and debated a new ordinance concerning ethical investment divestment. The body also passed resolutions regarding transgender rights and recent federal immigration enforcement activities within the city.

items.title: Remembrances and Recognitions
items.summary: Approved a memorial resolution for Richard Caraviello and congratulated Karen Breen on her retirement after 25 years as a school nurse.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the June 10, 2025 city council meeting.

items.title: Planning and Permitting Committee Report
items.summary: Approved the committee report from June 11 regarding corridor zoning and parking development demand management.

items.title: Public Hearing Continuations
items.summary: Continued hearings for a special permit at 282 Mystic Avenue to July 15 and proposed residential zoning amendments to October 21.

items.title: Automobile and Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved auto dealer license transfers for Herb Chambers and McGovern Automotive, and amended operating hours for Raising Cane's with an added condition prohibiting delivery truck idling.

items.title: Quincy Street Infrastructure and Rodent Issues
items.summary: Approved a resolution to address significant rat infestations, street paving defects, and traffic safety concerns at the intersection of Quincy and Osgood Streets.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriations and Year-End Transfers
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of over $8 million from free cash to the Capital Stabilization Fund and the Fire Department, as well as several internal fiscal year-end account transfers.

items.title: School Special Purpose Override Stabilization Fund
items.summary: Established a special purpose stabilization fund and transferred $2,185,000 from the school department budget to cover future contractual obligations.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Other Corridors
items.summary: Tabled the proposed zoning ordinance amendments for other corridors until the July 15 meeting.

items.title: Resolution Opposing Skrmetti v. United States Decision
items.summary: Approved a resolution opposing the Supreme Court decision regarding transgender medical care and calling for state-level protections.

items.title: Values Aligned Local Investments Ordinance
items.summary: Discussed an ordinance to divest city funds from fossil fuels, private prisons, weapons manufacturers, and human rights violators; the matter was postponed following a charter objection and extensive public testimony.

items.title: Police Report on Federal Immigration Activity
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting weekly after-action reports from the Medford Police Department regarding federal immigration enforcement activity in the city.
